seg: May the sun shine warm upon your face, your face so soft upon your face.
Until we meet again, until we meet again, may God my God hold you in the heart of His hand.
And until we meet again, until we meet again, may God hold you in the palm of His hand.
May the sun give your days bright, may the stars illuminate your night.
May the flowers bloom among your birth, your house and heaven is restored until we meet again, until we meet again.
